purpose: Planches conceptuelles pour futurs modèles 3D, sans instructions de culture

items.title: 01 — La compacte
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape 2D cartoon plant turnaround model sheet for future Blender 3D game asset creation. Visual style of Rick and Morty prop design, matching simple adult sci-fi cartoon character sheets. Bold slightly irregular black ink outlines, flat SOLID fills, at most ONE flat shadow tone per material. Strong simple readable chunky silhouettes. No realism, no photography, no realistic botanical illustration, no 3D rendering, no gradients, no tiny texture or crystalline trichome details. Plain white background, thin panel borders, plain French hand-lettered labels. Cannabis plant with recognizable palmate serrated finger leaves and stylized chunky flower clusters, non-anthropomorphic, no faces. Not a cultivation guide: no growth instructions, chemical information or instructional annotations. Layout upper row FOUR large FULL PLANT WITH POT views aligned at the same baseline and scale: FACE, PROFIL, DOS, TROIS-QUARTS. Same identical specimen, same branches, nodes, plant height, pot and materials across views. Orthographic front side back; back must rotate same branch structure and leaves rather than mirror label. Bottom row DESSUS (whole plant true overhead), FEUILLE (single complete palmate leaf), FLEUR (large simple chunky flower cluster), five palette swatches. Pot and tallest leaves never cropped. Plenty of breathing space. Modelable volumetric forms, no impossible floating leaves.  Exact title: « 01 — La compacte ». Design: A short stocky bright-to-dark GREEN cannabis plant with a squat wide triangular silhouette, thick short central stem, THREE pairs of stout lateral branches and a central apex, broad palmate leaves with FIVE short chunky serrated fingers. FIVE visible simple rounded green flower clusters with a few curved orange ink lines, not detailed realistic buds. Wide canopy wider than its height above pot. Simple squat terracotta pot with thick rim, dark flat soil circle. Pot is approximately one third overall height. Palette deep leaf green, lighter green clusters, terracotta, ink, dark soil. Keep extremely simple TV cartoon prop.
